hosted_ci.cause: The observation-noise development smoke writes schedule filenames containing colons, for example 'development:clean_trained:bouncing:correlated:000000:l000:e0000:r00.json'. actions/upload-artifact rejects colons for NTFS compatibility, so the upload step fails after every substantive step has already passed.

hosted_ci.pr11_evidence: PR #11's own latest checks fail identically: jobs 104234471652 and 104234465686 fail only at 'Retain failure evidence' with the same colon error. This branch adds no schedule file and modifies neither .github/workflows/ci.yml nor aaa/noise/runner.py.
hosted_ci.not_fixed_here_because: Fixing it would require modifying an existing file, which this assignment forbids. It is reported for a separate maintainer decision.
hosted_ci.side_note: This also undercuts any fallback story in which GitHub Actions artifacts serve as observation-noise evidence storage: for a noise run that upload cannot currently succeed at all.
